info.title: DispoRex API
info.description:
REST-API der Dispositionsplattform DispoRex. Alle Antworten enthalten `x-request-id`. Fehlerformat: `{ error: { code, message, details? }, requestId }`. Pagination über page/pageSize. Idempotenz über `Idempotency-Key` bei POST.

Verfügbare Scopes: dashboard:view, employees:read, employees:write, employees:documents, employees:export, employees:import, customers:read, customers:write, requests:read, requests:write, requests:convert, events:read, events:write, orders:read, orders:write, orders:confirm, shifts:read, shifts:write, shifts:assign, shifts:override_conflict, shifts:respond_own, availability:read, availability:write, availability:write_own, partners:read, partners:write, partners:respond_own, documents:read, documents:write, documents:confidential, time:import, time:read, time:correct, time:approve, reports:view, reports:export, billing:read, billing:write, notifications:admin, settings:read, settings:write, users:read, users:write, api_keys:manage, webhooks:manage, automations:manage, audit:read, ai:use, search:use, portal:customer, portal:partner, portal:employee.

Webhook-Ereignistypen: customer_request.created, customer_request.updated, event.created, event.updated, event.cancelled, order.confirmed, shift.created, shift.requested, shift.accepted, shift.declined, shift.confirmed, shift.withdrawn, shift.filled, shift.opened, partner_offer.created, partner_offer.responded, document.expiring, qualification.expiring, time_import.completed, reconciliation.deviation, reconciliation.corrected, notification.failed. Signatur: Header `X-DispoRex-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hmac_sha256(secret, "<t>.<body>")>`.

ApiKey.description: API-Schlüssel (drx_…) aus Einstellungen → API-Schlüssel. Scopes entsprechen Berechtigungen.
